_comment: SEED construction-bound corpus: test-grade, hand-authored, sufficient for the per-language e2e tests of the unsized-construction lane (pool, queue, cache, whole-body read). RC-055 for a connection pool is the arbitrated control. The control on the queue, cache and read entries is a stand-in for these tests only; the production corpus assigns it.

construction_bounds.rationale: database/sql opens connections without limit unless SetMaxOpenConns is positive
go-cache has no size cap; the default expiration is its only bound, and NoExpiration (-1) or 0 turns it off
ReadAll reads until EOF; only a limiting reader bounds it
queue.Queue with maxsize absent, zero or negative has no limit
asyncio.Queue with maxsize absent, zero or negative has no limit
a deque with no maxlen grows without limit
redis-py's ConnectionPool has no connection limit unless max_connections is given
lru_cache(maxsize=None) never evicts; the default maxsize is 128
functools.cache is lru_cache(maxsize=None): it has no bound to set
an unbounded channel has no capacity to set; Channel.CreateBounded is the bounded form
MemoryCache has no size cap unless MemoryCacheOptions.SizeLimit is set
ReadAllText holds the whole file in memory; it takes no limit
ReadAllBytes holds the whole file in memory; it takes no limit
